notes.title: Back2School - big discounts and a bundle
notes.content:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/cb1309be5ca688bafd8b13b5ab5989cd689c9826.png

Holidays are over, it's time to go back to school. After school though it's best to relax a bit and have some fun. We have prepared for you a bundle great for that and of course the discount for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27707/Back2School/

Here are the games you will get in the bundle:

 Bakery Simulator
 ZooKeeper
 Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)
 Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator
 Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator
 Commander '85
 Pangeon
 Foodtruck Arena
 Bouncy Bob: Episode 2
 Gunslingers & Zombies

 1. Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)) where you learn Physics- How the furniture in the apartment reacts when a refrigerator enters it through the window, Mathematics - Calculating the angle account when throwing cows to the fence, and Art - Painting pictures while having fun with tossing cows and smashing everything.

2. ZooKeeper  where you learn Natural Sciences - different animal species, their reactions, and characteristics and Business Studies - the basics of ZOO, animals, and staff management while having the pleasure of watching animals and creating your own zoo

3. Bakery Simulator where you learn Cooking - Baking to be precise. You will get a basic knowledge how what the baking process looks like and you find out what kind of machines bakers use and have fun baking your favorite bread in the game and then doing it in real life! 

4. Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator where you learn Technology - many kinds of bombs that can be found nowadays, how to disarm them, and how dangerous the sapper's job can really be and have fun searching for a bomb and having the thrill of disarming it just in time.

5. Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator where you learn History - Never heard of ancient times? Romans, Gauls? Those two nations didn't like each other too much. Physics - what can happen if a catapult's stone hit a big group of units? Have fun using magic, traps, and catapults.

6. Commander '85 where you learn History - Experience what it was like in the 1980s. How some feared war and feared new technologies coming into our lives... The rise of computers Science - Find out how computers worked in the 1980s, and how hard it was to operate them compared to the present while having fun with challenging gameplay, where there are no tutorials, no help, no easy solutions. There is only you, a small monitor screen, and commands.

7. Pangeon where you learn IT - how to use only pixels, that create blurry pictures to make a game in the times of hyper-realistic graphics while having fun searching the dungeons and killing monsters.

8. Foodtruck Arena where you learn PE - In most physical challenges, good cooperation is always vital. It is not different here. Arena, football, cars, cooperation. That's quite a good combo to get a lot of fun.

9. Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 where you learn what to do on School break - how to cope with your friends when no one tells you what to do or not do!

10. Gunslingers & Zombies - Face Zombie Apocalypse in Wild West. Manage your crew in a Turn-based strategy and adventure game. Survive, scavenge, and explore the world. Use the different talents of your team members and develop your tactics. Resolve the zombie mystery.


When your mom comes in saying "stop playing, it's time to learn something" - you just need to show this.

One more thing... Check our upcoming game Electrician Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

Good Luck and Have Fun, fellow gamers! :)

As the game launches fully tomorrow we thought it's the high time to let you know about some clever tricks and objects you might want to use to give yourself an edge in the campaign against The Green that starts tomorrow. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/b16d480f061f8599a8efafb777877e74d1f967bb.png

Make sure to be aware of barrels! They can be your biggest ally but also can spell your doom - depending on how you use them. If you shoot them they will explode and damage all nearby units. That's only true for the situations where you failed to kill them with your attack. To emulate something a bit similar you can click on the defend button - as you do it, you will spend an action point and finish the action for a particular character but they will be able to shoot a zombie as soon as they enter the character's vision. It might be helpful if you prefer to let them come to you instead of charging them head-first!

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #44 - ”Upcoming patch”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers!

Has it been a while, ain't it? They say as vast as Prairie is, all the roads eventually lead up to Saloon, so we have finally met again.

Today we bring some news. Big news. Zombies are back, now more relentless than ever.

Soon we will introduce Big Patch to the Gunslingers & Zombies, and this day marks the day we are calling the cavalry and moving on towards Full Release.

From now on we are back to Devloging development of the game, and those Devlogs should appear every second or third Friday.

Today we would like to share a list of upcoming changes with You. Currently, we are busy with playtesting this patch, and some shiny pieces of code still need to be put together.

Campaign 


 Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards - improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.

 Creation of 6 new missions - More story, more zombies and more shooting.

 Implementation of difficulty level - creating 3 difficulty levels: easy,
normal and hard.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/6ee13f47d477a870a0d5a81be951432def0a4327.jpg

Enemies
Addition of 3 new enemy classes

 "Hunter" Zombie, which attacks at a distance,
 "Boomer" Zombie, which when killed explodes with poisonous gas and deals damage friendly units (other zombies are immune),
 "Hub" Zombie, which after death spawns two smaller zombies of "Pocket" type,


Zombie Changes:

 Enemies now also have various amounts of Health in opposition to static 10 HP before.
 Zombie stats like Health, Speed or Damage now depend on chosen difficulty.
 Enemy Counter-attack - Adding mechanics for counter-attacking enemy units. During
attacking an enemy in melee, if the enemy is not killed, the enemy in retaliation will attack the character right after receiving damage. The mechanics will further enhance the
The mechanics will further enhance the gameplay experience and significantly influence the player's strategy,
 Improvement of the AI that spawns during the game


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/923a9c69b2f64065de3c78e06dd1859be43f7c15.png

Gameplay mechanics changes:

Adding interactive on-ground items:

 adding an exploding barrel which dealing area of effect damage to enemy and friendly units,
 adding an ammo crate, where heroes can replenish their ammo supply
 adding a bandages supply crate
 adding an explosive cart

Adding character interaction with a diagonal object:

 Standing diagonally from an interactive object will also be able to interact with the object.
 Gunslingers can also attack diagonally now.

Adding confirmation of character movement:

 adding a mechanic to confirm the path of a character's movement. The first LPM click marks the path the character is moving, and a second click in the same place confirms the character's movement.

Balancing changes of knife attack
 was a little OP. Now it's more in line with ranged weapons together with enemy HP changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/fd78544b0e06cb5a12c2a34ffe048e20bae6787e.png

Additionally
Improving the soundtrack:

 improving the sounds of some weapons,
 improving some of the sound effects that already exist in the game,
 adding sound effects to newly created mechanics

Modifying the UI when hovering the cursor over an enemy

 improving the visual effect of the UI, in which the information about the chance of
 damage chance and critical damage chance. Removal of zombie names and
 replacing them with zombie types.

Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards

 improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.

Introduction of several corrections and improvements, including:

  changing the colour of the first movement zone,
  adding an active counter-attack mode symbol to the UI,
  improved ESC function,
  Improved critical damage designation,


- Creation of keyboard shortcuts,

- Marking the number of actions on the sidebar

- Adding the ability to play in a window,

- Turning off grids during the attack cutscene

- Creation of new "goals," i.e. heal maximum Health, kill a zombie with a knife etc.

- Some more various minor fixes

And most probably some more changes are coming soon. Right now, it's hard to estimate new updates coming live, but it's weeks, not months, shooting at the calendar.


See You Next Friday and Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

As you're going to be put in charge of the cowboys and gunslingers appearing in the game very soon we believe it will not hurt to remind you about some of the general rules of the game that we hope you will have a lot of fun with! Let's collectively take some advice from... the game itself! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/85135867e9a7c986c50cc447939b2adffac8932b.png

Advice No. 1 - Zombies can't see you unless you are in the red zone of their sight. You can always check it if you simply mouse over the zombie. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/ec94d90a98e691a8c749d2095452ea7b677ebe36.png

Advice No. 3 - Check your opponents! You can learn their health points, you will see a hit chance of your own attack and many more! Be sure to search for the opportunities to flank the opponents in order to maximize your chances of survival and the chance to kill a zombie with one hit! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/874ec2fbb12ff9b9e3899d2297161e0fa13c90a8.png

Advice No. 4 - Be mindful of your teammates! Heal them when they need healing or simply move them back to allow them a much needed breather. notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #42 - ”Life of a Zombie”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers!

We’ve got so preoccupied with killing zombies that we’ve never ever stopped for a single moment to wonder what their life looks like...

Of course - you don’t quite get a chance to ponder about the life of someone who is actively trying to bite your head off however in those few moments of peace and quiet thoughts tend to drift away from the mundane problems of life and start to focus on things normally… unthinkable. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/1872d1d90a251209ddd6f653a7b104b044fc7c10.png

For example - Josephine, right there in the picture above, did we ever wonder what her story is? How did she become a zombie, what had happened in her past? While obviously we can only imagine the details the game itself provides us with a very short description of her story as a zombie. In her case… well… I don’t think anyone is going to be Josephine’s friend ever again… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/78cfb721acb32db776ac716e6011e943e0d0e815.png
 
Let’s focus on Mike. See? He might have been a very regular person, completely ordinary guy who… bit a leg. That’s a bit strange. I cannot help but wonder - did he do that to his own leg or did he bit someone’s leg? I’m not quite sure but allow me to maintain my distance from Mike. I kind of need my legs... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/76f0ac9dfbe66c469b14f2a73827c78a8dbd3bdc.png

But it’s not like all Zombies are so aggressive and went through periods of unjustified aggression toward other people. Some of them just didn’t quite like the radio playing near their location and decided to swallow the thing. Interesting thing is that perhaps they did it in one big gulp? And now they have the radio eternally playing in their stomach, attracting other zombies to them… In a way Allen made himself to be a real party animal… or should I say party zombie? Zombie animal?
 
If you get a chance - give yourself a moment to think about the zombies and their past. Who knows what will you discover!

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #41 - ”Strategic approach!”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers!

Fighting zombies is not just about shooting and slicing your opponents! Without proper strategy you might find yourself at the mercy (or rather lack of it) of the horde!

Early Access Release - 15.01.21 - Don't miss it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/fd78544b0e06cb5a12c2a34ffe048e20bae6787e.png

Sometimes it might be just enough to play the mission by ear. Throw some of your units here, lead them to the other place, fight whoever comes by and in the end somehow secure a win… But in more complicated situations where there are many zombies around and they all approach you from different angles you might quickly understand that it’s not enough to just blindly shoot them all as they come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/aafcec4a54b8b03ef70785c7005ba5354ff0f053.png
 
You might want to employ some kind of tactic at that point then. For example - take a look at the screenshot above - you can try to defend each other in a sturdy turtle tactic where all your characters are next to each other and they all cover for each other. It’s a defensive tactic but it sometimes will work wonders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/b3f50b681dc000b9cdf2f6252dc82f7313825f8a.png

Obviously, if you prefer to gain some terrain and want to move from the spot you’re defending you might prefer something a little bit different. 2 frontliners and 2 backliners sometimes will work great and also let you save some ammunition to use later. By switching members of two lines you will ensure they all stay relatively healthy and always ready to act!
 
Don’t underestimate the number of Zombies and make sure that you’re playing according to your greatest strength - your brain!

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #39 - ”Weapons statistics”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers! 

We've already talked a little about different weapons that you will be able to use in the game but this time we would like to let you see statistics for some of the guns that you will be able to use in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/8d9ddcb8f26adada716cfe12d8e0993497a3df87.png

Different weapons do different things or at least do them in a different way. As you might imagine knife is essential in close combat - that's an easy thing to spot. But what about the differences between different type of guns? Let's take a look at them.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/ab6dace2fa3517b959d1761ac0fdbce4914af995.png

Reunion is a revolver with a limited range and not the best damage. It's accuracy is quite good and it boasts 10% chance of doing critical damange. It also has 6 bullets in its magazine which is always an important factor since it times the moment when you will have to reload the gun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/fb87fecbd2bdb9d7921116236f7aa666a6fc05c7.png
 
Winbuster has overall better statistics than the revolver. You might ask - why would I use the other one than this one? Well, obviously, you will not always have an easy access to the bullets for this particular gun while revolver might be a little bit easier to obtain. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/585f0d8eafabd0138e7678a5cb3f50f0a7ffa723.png

Hereford is a shotgun that boast higher damage than Winbuster, however it comes with some drawbacks - mainly a limited amount of bullets that it can hold at the same time. In the end it will depend on you how well will you use it in combination with other guns.  

Many other guns might find their way into your hands so be sure to always check their statistics to not be surprised!

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #38 - ”Stars and goals”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers! 

There’s nothing quite like a feeling of victory. After all winning is so enjoyable and we all like to win… but there’s one thing better than winning – it’s winning in style!

Think about – there are certain moments in your life when you can do bare minimum in order to somehow scrape by. Well, you can even do the least required thing and still win in something but we strongly believe that if one is to do something they should do it as close to perfect as possible. In Gunslingers & Zombies we will have a goal and stars system to check how well did you manage to defend your characters and their cities.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/f4c4376a46e2b35c47d3c224925763da61711524.png

As you can see on the right side of the screen – there are particular goals that you need to be mindful of when playing through a mission. Those goals can be different and only by fulfilling all of them will you be able to achieve the highest possible rating – 3 stars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/55f381ff3053212130166f1872a2cb185e8925e8.png
 
If by some unfortunate accident you will not be able to get all of the goals as in the picture above, where we weren’t able to save one of the currently burning buildings, then you will still be able to finish the mission however not with 3 stars. The other possibilities are of course two stars and one star.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/9b59d067d440a8fcf391718de5e5a97877b20c84.png

Of course you can always repeat the mission to try and achieve that perfect score so make yourself comfortable and aim for the highest possible mark! 

It’s all about style…

Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #36 - ”Hold on, I’m reloading!”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers! 

There’s no point to a gun without ammunition and as such there’s no point in ammunition if it’s not in the gun. During the game you will have to always be on the lookout for more ammo!

You might be tempted to unload the rain of bullets on the incoming hordes of zombies but you always need to remember about proper ammunition management in the game. Let’s look at this example. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/b01be759437a45d4dd0d35d47775c79441a5c053.png 

Everything seems right, doesn’t it? It seems like our guy has a lot of ammunition at his disposal so he should be relatively safe, right? Sure, that’s correct but as you can see in the bottom right corner those 13 bullets is all he has left. After shooting them all he will be left with no way to use his trusty Winbuster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/c4af048cb865dd7ca07b700059ba3e271a530f52.png 

In this particular situation we can see that we do have some more ammunition to use on the radio-crazed zombie but the ammo needs to be loaded into a gun – and that takes time! Time is a valuable commodity, as they say, and in the time where our hero will reload the gun it is quite possible that the zombie will be able to chomp off his head!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/ea52561fd24d0b551f0d41a3095a729aae653b17.jpg

In the end sometimes you will be forced to use a knife and that’s absolutely fine too. Maybe you’re left with no ammunition or maybe you prefer to save a round this turn and fight the green opponent with more conventional means – the decision is yours. 
Remember to plan ahead the way you are going to use guns and ammunition. You never know when you’ll need it the most.


Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #35 - ”Art of War”
notes.content:
Hello Gunslingers! 

Have your eyes got accustomed to the horrible and all-encompassing fog of war that tightly hugs the whole map? Yes? That’s great because now we’re gonna talk about the proper war.

War it is. When confronted with masses of living dead a word “war” seems to do justice to the situation our heroes got put in. And as with any war there are some possibilities mastering which might increase your chance of being alive when the dust settles. Let’s look at the possibilities. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/f323fa875d88d4d252a998e3814c142e88c54b6e.jpg 

Well, obviously, we can shoot, stab and we can do much more to make sure that the zombies will not rise up again. This one is a given, however you always need to make sure that you are not bringing a knife to pistol fight. Select your weapons wisely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/26f8aff67f2e942137155baf3360fa175da5e64b.jpg
 
You are sure to be surrounded in next few moments? Oh boy… If that’s the case maybe it’s better to focus on the defense, you know, instead of attacking? Sure, they do say that the best defense is an offense, but we would rather stay alive and with all parts attached, aren’t we, partner?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/dacb440b79554d70999e13100244be5183766e42.jpg

Team players are those who survive the most, provided they also have team players around them. If you see your buddy almost saying hello to the grim reaper – toss him a bandage, will ya? Or just take care of your own injuries, whatever lets you sip your whisky easier, I won’t judge. 

Mastering all of these choices and choosing wisely will definitely add years to your life, trust me.

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #23 - ”Famous Gunslingers”
notes.content:
Dear Gunslingers & Zombies Fans!

▪ Do you know any famous Gunslingers from books, games or history?

Today we collect some interesting stories for you.

James “Wild Bill” Hickok

One of the most famous gunfighter, gambler, and lawman in the American Old West history. 
He fought (and spied) for the Union Army during the American Civil War. After the war, he gained fame as a scout, marksman, and professional gambler.

He was involved in several loud duels! 🔫🔫🔫

What's interesting, he was afraid of being shot in the back, so in the places he visited, he always tried to sit down so that there was a wall behind him. On the day he died, he could not find such a place!

Hickok was inducted into the Poker Hall of Fame. The card hand he held at the time of his death is known today as poker's "Dead Man's Hand". 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/f8367cbd1ed16513ce52517457f25861f274d02a.png
Source: The History Reader


Roland Deschain

The last gunslinger, who has been chasing his adversary, "the man in black," for many years. The first of many steps toward Roland's ultimate destination, The Dark Tower.

The novel fuses Western fiction with fantasy, science fiction, and horror written by Stephen King. 

It took King twelve-and-a-half years to finish the novel. 

Series have 7 books! 📕📗📘

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/3cd0f2b5ecad59cceb62b4d848b6ad1efe94bab3.png
Source: Marvel Comics


Arthur Morgan

Red Dead Redemption 2 focuses on his life and position in the notorious Van der Linde gang. The game follows the gang's decline as they are pursued by lawmen, fellow gangs and Pinkerton agents.

Set in a fictional recreation of the American Old West in 1899. 🏇🌄

Open world, a fictionalized representation of the Western, Midwestern and Southern United States, was praised as one of the greatest in video gaming!

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #10 - ”Army of the dead”
notes.content:
Hello Cowboys

Today we want to present to you our first attempt at adding enemies and how the system of combat works.

“In this dry desert in the town between nowhere some strange person was slowly moving towards the living. First...Second...Third...Countless! What we could do? We start shooting at them! They were already dead - we could only try to send them to their grave once more!”
Our combat system is presented as a turn strategy game. We want to keep it and we are trying to achieve that by Giving player Action Points that he can spend for moving and shooting targets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/e352fa6ea51b61c9498cd8ec9b87911f053339c0.jpg

Each action costs a certain amount of Action Points. For example - We want to move our gunslinger closer, to get a better chance to hit. We didn’t spend all of our Action Points so we can shoot at him! After that, we have one or two AP left, so we can try to run away from the horde of zombies to get another chance to hit. Zombies will come closer, because they have their own Action Points pull. They won’t be stopped by a single bullet! Can we outrun the horde of zombies? Well if we will make smart moves - like running and shooting - yes. But also some help from fellow companions would be a great assistance. What would you do in that kind of situation? Would you run by and shoot the targets? Dig up somewhere? Or maybe you would call for the assistance? After all, zombies can be sent to their graves once more… If you will have enough ammo.

Tell us in the comment what you would do in this situation!

Best regards
GUNSLINGERS & ZOMBIES TEAM
